description: Paginate the COMPLETE set of entities linked to a parent MBID — every release-group by an artist, every release on a label, every recording of a work, every release in a release-group. This is the only complete-enumeration path: the get_* tools embed at most one page (25) of any linked list, so use this tool whenever a linked set may exceed a page (a prolific artist, a major label with thousands of releases, a heavily-covered work). Provide exactly ONE link MBID matching a valid parent→child relationship for the target_type. Pages arbitrarily deep via offset; totalCount is the true upstream total.

link.description: Exactly one parent MBID. The valid key depends on target_type (see the description).

area.description: Parent area MBID (artists/labels in this area).

artist.description: Parent artist MBID (e.g. release-groups/recordings/releases by this artist).

label.description: Parent label MBID (releases on this label).

recording.description: Parent recording MBID (releases containing this recording).

release-group.description: Parent release-group MBID (releases in this group).

work.description: Parent work MBID (recordings of this work).

target_type.description: The entity type to enumerate (the children).

name: musicbrainz_browse_entities

cap.description: The page size that was applied. Absent when not truncated.

entities.description: This page of linked entities, in upstream order.

items.description: A lightweight reference to a linked entity.

artistCredit.description: Credited artist string, for release-group/release/recording. Omitted otherwise.

country.description: Country code, where applicable. Omitted when absent.

date.description: First-release/release date, where applicable. Omitted when absent.

length.description: Recording length as m:ss. Omitted when not a recording / unknown.

mbid.description: Entity MBID — chain to the matching musicbrainz_get_* tool.

type.description: Entity subtype, where applicable. Omitted when absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_link`: No link MBID was provided, more than one was provided, or the link MBID is malformed (HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The link MBID is well-formed but no such parent entity exists (HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

linkMbid.description: The parent MBID that was browsed.

linkType.description: The parent link type used (artist, label, release-group, recording, work, or area).

notice.description: How to page further when results remain, or guidance when empty.

offset.description: The offset used for this page.

shown.description: Number of entities returned in this page. Absent when not truncated.

targetType.description: The entity type that was enumerated.

totalCount.description: True total number of linked entities upstream (the {type}-count field).

truncated.description: True when more entities remain beyond this page (offset + shown < totalCount). Absent when the page is complete.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: browse entities
